subject: Re: Kickoff: BAM - one multi-task NLU model to replace the classifier fleet
body:
Priya,

Staffing: Linnea 60% (multi-task training), Rafael 50% (distillation), through mid-July.

On data hygiene - this is the part I want funded properly. Merging eleven tasks' training sets into one multi-task corpus means cross-task contamination becomes a real evaluation risk: near-duplicate utterances show up in one task's train and another's test. That means building a dataset de-duplication pipeline from scratch: exact-hash first pass, then n-gram overlap detection between every task's training set and every other task's eval set. Maren scopes and owns it at 50% for the next two months; nothing internal exists for this today, so we're designing it as reusable infrastructure rather than a one-off script.

Compute: multi-task fine-tuning is TPU-friendly, so I'm requesting a cirrus-tpu slice from the language portfolio's quarterly allocation rather than fighting for GPU reservations.

Ivo
